module: Flowgraph node 'Nonlinear Smoother' (simple category). Nonlinear smoothing with newTemporalSmoothingNonLinear: upRate/downRate depending on direction, time step 'dt', 'set' to force the state. Output 'value'. Pin descriptions are 'TODO' in the code.
notes: init writes C.oldSet (class) instead of self.oldSet.
The smoother is created in init, so it is not reset when the graph restarts (unlike the Linear Smoother).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Sets C.oldSet=0 (class) and creates the nonlinear smoother.

checkSetValue.desc: If 'set' changed, forces the smoother state.

work.desc: With no input, outputs the state; otherwise outputs smoother:getWithRate(sample, dt, rate) with rate = upRate/downRate (default 1).
